messages:
Anna (partnerships): Quick sync — finalizing the partner support escalation/handoff for CloudHub marketplace launch tomorrow morning. Need: warroom channel name, primary oncall, 30-min triage checklist, and the automated bridge trigger. Ping @Jess, @Mike, @Sam, @Kai.

Jess (marketplace-pm): +1. my proposal: one shared channel for initial comms + a warroom for active SEVs. Naming conv: `#partner-cloudhub-<env>-support` and auto-create `#warroom-cloudhub-<env>-sev`.

Mike (partner-ops): love that. For prod I suggest `#partner-cloudhub-prod-support` and warroom `#warroom-cloudhub-prod-sev-<id>` (id = date/time). We'll need a short handoff doc for the partner L2 team with contact tree. Link: https://redwood.internal/handbooks/cloudhub-handoff (draft).

Sam (oncall-sre): FWIW, oncall routing: paging goes to `infra-oncall` first for infra-level faults, else `partner-ops` -> partner L2. If the partner channel is unresponsive after 10m escalate to `primary-eng-lead`. Add an automatic fallback model.

Kai (partner-se): For SEV definitions:
- SEV1: outage/customer-facing crash — immediate bridge + paging to @Sam and @Mike.
- SEV2: degraded but operational — post to partner-support channel and 15m check-in.
- SEV3: informational.

Anna (partnerships): Kai can you paste a minimal triage checklist we can pin to the channel? Keep it to 6 bullets.

Kai (partner-se): Sure — paste below: 
```
1) Confirm scope & number of customers affected
2) Confirm whether model/config/version pinned
3) Capture logs + recent deploys (commit + deploy id)
4) Run quick mitigation (roll back / scale up / route to replica)
5) Notify partner L2 and record contact method
6) Timebox investigation & escalate if no progress in 15m
```

Mike (partner-ops): Perfect. For automation, we can add a tiny snippet to our alert manager to POST to the bridge service: 
```
curl -X POST https://bridge.redwood.internal/create -d '{"partner":"cloudhub","env":"prod","sev":"1"}'
```
Response will include bridge link + warroom name. ops-bot should announce it.

ops-bot: New warroom created -> #warroom-cloudhub-prod-sev-20240318-0932 (bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridges/abc123)

Jess (marketplace-pm): Can we standardize the initial message template the bot posts? e.g.:
```
[SEV1] CloudHub - Prod
Status: Investigating
Bridge: <link>
Primary: @Sam (oncall-sre)
Partner L2: CloudHub Support (cloudhub-support@example.com)
```

Sam (oncall-sre): Yes. Also add a quick checklist for owners: who runs postmortem, who updates customer comms. Recommend: partner-ops + marketplace-pm share postmortem.

Anna (partnerships): Action items: 
- Mike: finalize handoff doc & shared channel perms by EOD (owner: Mike)
- Kai: pin triage checklist & SEV definitions to the partner channel (owner: Kai)
- Sam: update alert manager to call bridge POST for SEV1 (owner: Sam)
- Jess: confirm partner L2 contact info and add to doc (owner: Jess)

Mike (partner-ops): noted. I'll also add a one-click escalation button in the shared channel (ops-bot integration).

Jess (marketplace-pm): I'll run a 10-min dry-run 1h before launch to validate notifications.

Anna (partnerships): Thanks all — this looks good. If nothing else, I'll create the channel names now and invite CloudHub. :thumbsup:

Mike (partner-ops): 👍

Sam (oncall-sre): 👍

Kai (partner-se): 👍

Anna (partnerships): Closing thread — will post final links to the channel once created.
